description: Land Acquisition - The Land Compensation at Welewatta, Magoda Kolonnawa, Sedawatjhtha, Kolonnawa D/S DIvision, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices about compensation payments for specific land parcels being acquired by the government, including multiple schedules with land descriptions, locations, lot numbers, extents, and case numbers. The content falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" including "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes). There are no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized category elements present.
